content.comment_body: Hello [company_name], I have a digital weighing device with an RS232 interface. Can you provide guidance on how to connect and read values from it? Thank you!
This is not possible because [product_name] can only read digital and analog signals. It does not support communication with RS232 devices; the serial interface is only used for programming.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to connect a digital weighing device with RS232 interface to the [product_name] [version_no]. Another user explains that this is not supported, as the hardware only handles digital and analog values and cannot communicate with RS232 devices except for programming. This demonstrates a connectivity limitation for this product.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects the [product_name] [version_no] to allow direct communication and data retrieval from an RS232 device.
